faces.name: The Mystery Booster
faces.oracleText:
Rulebreaker companion — A deck with this commander or companion can have ONLY cards from any Mystery Booster set and playtest cards of any color identity, as well as any basic land cards.
Whenever The Mystery Booster attacks, look at the top fifteen cards of your library. You may cast a Mystery Booster or playtest spell from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.

faces.name: The Mystery Raceway
faces.oracleText:
Start your engines!
{T}: Add {C}.
Max Speed — {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, {T}: Mill seven cards. Choose a playtest card from among them. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. If Team Cloudspire won the race, copy it and you may choose new targets for the copy. If Team Speed Demons won the race, each opponent loses life equal to its mana value.
The Mystery Raceway can be your commander.

faces.name: The Mystical Archive
faces.oracleText:
As this land enters, draft a card from The Mystical Archive's spellbook and exile it face down.
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast spells that aren't from your starting deck.
{2}, {T}: Put a card exiled with this land into its owner's hand.
